questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The growing population of India will have been controlled by the Indian government by 2040.

options.text: By 2040, the Indian population will have continued to grow uncontrollably
By 2040, the Indian government will have controlled the growing population of India.
By 2040, the Indian government is successfully controlling the growing population of India.
The Indian population will have stabilised by 2022.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **By 2040, the Indian government will have controlled the growing population of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in passive voice, with the **subject **(**the growing population of India**) receiving the action.
 
• To convert it to active voice, we need to make the **subject the doer** of the action.
 
• The Indian government is the doer of the action, so it should be the subject of the sentence in active voice.
 
• We also need to change the verb tense from future perfect passive to future perfect active.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.
